query:
-- 1. Molécules sans CID PubChem (candidates à être des matières premières)
SELECT id, name, chemical_family, olfactive_family, cas_number, pubchem_cid, source
FROM molecules
WHERE pubchem_cid IS NULL OR pubchem_cid = ''
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 100;
